items.objective: In src/candidate.cpp, investigate recurrence-preserving loop-control changes such as modest inner-loop unrolling or pointer-based traversal, keeping every update in the original order. First isolate their effect with a fixed population-count implementation; then measure at least one promising combined loop-and-count variant if available. Do not parallelize the recurrence or specialize to benchmark dimensions. Preserve uint32 wraparound, generic valid inputs, output overwrite, and the threads budget; validate and measure each complete program using the official protocol.
